s1.desc: a bedroom with a wooden bed with duck-topped bedposts, drawn on a plain grey background

spans.view: with a fish-shaped lamp and a mug on the nightstand, the room dim

beats.text: Pax lies under the blanket staring at a phone held close to his face, its glow lighting him, while Polly lies propped up beside him
Polly narrows her eyes into a glare at Pax while he keeps staring at the glowing phone
Polly glares as her face flushes red with anger, while Pax keeps his eyes on the phone

spans.notes: slow push-in through the whole shot: motion on the bed and blanket (y0.55-0.85) scale 1.005 at f4 -> 1.062 at f56 (cc 0.95-0.97), lamp band agrees; compare 0/59 every bed edge doubled. Steady night tint over the whole shot (luma ~152, no flicker); the only light change is the phone glow on Pax's face (local light). The phone back faces out (lenses visible), its screen faces Pax; the insert that follows shows it is the iFin, but it is not identifiable here, so 'a phone'. The mug on the nightstand has a penguin face printed in the mug's own orange colour, neither Pax nor Polly (read as a prop; if read as a lead depiction this becomes lead_copy). No caption or watermark

phone-screen insert: Pax's flipper scrolls a food-delivery app on the iFin (tuft on top) and moves to the checkout screen; only his flipper and a sliver of his body are visible. The app names a KFC parody restaurant (also ad_merch-like UI text). No lead face visible
